name: Urethane
aliases: Ethyl carbamate, Aethylcarbamat, Aethylurethan, Carbamic acid ethyl ester, Carbamidsaeure-aethylester, Estane 5703, Ethyl ester of carbamic acid, Ethyl urethan
summary: Ethyl carbamate (also called urethane) is an organic compound with the formula CH3CH2OC(O)NH2. It is an ester of carbamic acid and a white solid. Despite its name, it is not a component of polyurethanes. Because it is a carcinogen, it is rarely used, but naturally forms in low quantities in many types of fermented foods and drinks.
